desc:
SEND WORD - THE END IS NIGH


BEFORE PLAYING:
You should acknowledge that the game is currently in a prototype phase.
Meaning it's rough, janky, and full of surprises while in-dev.
And while it is playable, it is yet to be fully polished. 
Expect bugs. Everything is subject to change.

At any second, such life could change forever.
Falling endlessly into The Vast.
The beautiful world waits.
Will you live to see them rise or fall?

Inspired by the likes of: Pillar Chase 2, Sonic.EXE: The Disaster and Dead By Daylight.
Revolving around a Killer facing a team of 8 Survivors.
All characters featured are primarily from Roblox Digital Horror series or Roblox Horror alike.
Made as a gift for the Roblox ARG Community.

(Lists every series that has upcoming content for PWNed)
